handshape.note: Flat/open right hand: FingerController curl=0 all fingers, spread=0.1; thumb curl=0.1. Left hand stays neutral.

pose_semantics.f10: Dominant flat hand at lips/lower face (GOOD onset per SV-ASL-002).
pose_semantics.f20: Hand moves away/down-forward, orientation opening outward (GOOD stroke).
pose_semantics.f40: Return to neutral so AvatarController 'finished' -> ASL_NEUTRAL transition stays clean.
